data: Named ranges, sheet copies and file import
Save a range by name, duplicate a sheet, and open CSV and TSV files.

Jump back to a named range. Name a selection from the sheet menu or command palette. Use Go to Named Range to find it again, even after rows or columns move. Named ranges guide.

Duplicate a sheet or import a file. Make a copy with its formulas, formatting and notes. Use Import CSV or TSV to open a file in its own sheet. Sheet guide.
